All 19 real ones by cause: U3 11, U4 6, U1 1, U8 1.
mechanisms: A T2 defence frame built alone at a metal store of 0 in the path of his T2 army: armhlt_30842 (400 metal, 91%) stood 157 s at about 1% every 1-3 s, with spending equal to income and six labs producing, and an unseen Banisher killed it at 30:36-30:43; at full rate it would have stood near 30:12 (an inference). Spending priority for the defence, or a second builder on it, would have kept up to 400.

Forward extractor and turret builds left alone against lone-corgator raids for twenty minutes: the raider came during the build at spots 1,400-3,500 from home with no escort and no finished turret (armmex_6304, armmex_18847, armllt_12458, armllt_15814, armllt_1832, armllt_13591, armllt_11366, armmex_12149, armmex_12528, armllt_25508, plus the corwolv's armllt_13435 and armmex_11072: 12 frames, 317 metal). An escort or a guard group at the building spot would have kept most of it; the report's 'turret' word also counted an unfinished turret frame (9:37 B4, 12:26 E7).

The queued help promoted by a neighbour's frame finishing: the hands' finished-event handler matches a builder's started build by type within 250 of its site, not by the frame's id, so armsolar_904 finishing 213 away made the commander leave armsolar_28188 at 98% for a guard of the plant (152 metal). Matching the finished unit to the task's own frame id would have kept it.
unread: Nothing torn or skipped (one seat, every file read). Not settled by the tools: who built armsolar_28188 up to 87% at 2:35-2:36 (the commander on its fight order is the only reading; the record carries no target), and whether the metal stall alone cost armhlt_30842 (a build-time inference). frames.py's 'decayed' (and floor.py's aband, 9 = 9) count 6 frames killed by unseen enemies (armllt_13435, armmex_11072, armmex_12528, armllt_8038, armhlt_30842, armrl_8479: 489 metal), and floor's aband_m (131) multiplies the share after decay or damage, where frames.py (705 for the decayed) takes the peak.
